name: NotebookLM
description: An AI-powered research and notebook assistant by Google that allows users to generate insights, manage sources, and interact with documents.

evidence.claim: NotebookLM Enterprise provides REST APIs for notebook creation and management using Google Cloud IAM access tokens.
Community MCP server exists for NotebookLM allowing agentic interaction with sources, chat, and library management.

notes: NotebookLM Enterprise provides official Google Cloud IAM / OAuth2 token-based REST APIs for notebook management. Community libraries and MCP servers also provide wrappers around unofficial or extended endpoints.
search_queries_used: NotebookLM authentication OAuth API key developer docs
